walk_notes: ⚠️⚠️ TRUST WARNING — ADDED 2026-08-24. READ BEFORE USING ANY ROW BELOW.
The generator that wrote this file is ICED. Measured across all 27 asset
files (115 authority-layer rows), only 42 rows — 36.5% — are trustworthy:
⚠ `timelock: unresolved`  = NOT MEASURED. It does not mean "no timelock".
⚠ `topology: nofm-multisig` = the terminal is a Safe whose getThreshold()
was NEVER CALLED. The `m` field is len(keys[]) — a KEY-SLOT COUNT, not a
threshold — despite schema.md:466 annotating it "signers in the set".
Worked example: syrupusdc asset-permission reads m:1 while the real Safe
is 4-of-7.
⚠ `terminal: ambiguous-authority` = the walk STOPPED, not a leaf. At least
one real single-key layer (poolDelegate on syrupUSDC/USDT) sits below one
of these and is absent from this file entirely.
✅ Trustworthy: `topology: single-eoa`, and timelocks with a real duration.
Why: audits/topology-coverage-2026-08-24.md    Method now: manual walks.

riskAnalyst assets/hastra-prime.md — compromise_threshold, signer_independence,
basis, note, severity_cap. See registry/schema.md.
Source: riskAnalyst assets/hastra-prime.md, topology_verified_at 2026-07-31.
⚠️ Three layers with different topologies each. Never collapse to one value per
asset — custody is 1-of-3 while contract-upgrade is a single key, and picking
either one alone misstates the surface.
No `keys[]` on any layer: the source enumerates COUNTS of accounts (3 group
members, 6 marker authorities, 1 CosmWasm admin), not named authority slots the
way CASH's Token-2022 extensions are. `keys` is left absent rather than
back-filled from prose — an invented enumeration is worse than a gap.
⚠ `chain:` BACKFILLED provenance on 2026-08-19 — riskAnalyst ef135b9. All three
layers govern PRIME's BACKING and live on Provenance: the redeem vault holding
99.7% of backing (custody), the uylds.fcc marker with six FORCE_TRANSFER keys
over the UNDERLYING (asset-permission), and the CosmWasm admin of both receipt
tokens and the HELOC pool (contract-upgrade) — "the most severe single key in
the structure". The seed was substantively RIGHT and merely unlabelled.
⚠ PRIME IS NOT DEPLOYED ON PROVENANCE. `chains:` lists DEPLOYMENT chains
(ethereum, solana); a layer's `chain:` is where the AUTHORITY lives. For a
wrapper backed on another chain these differ BY CONSTRUCTION, so the coverage
check flags declared-but-unwalked and stays silent on walked-but-undeclared.
observed_at UNCHANGED: this labels which chain the existing reads described.
⚠ MISSING LAYER, blocked on merge mode: PRIME's own Ethereum upgrade authority
(ERC1967Proxy -> verified TimelockController, getMinDelay() = 86400 = 1d)
belongs here as contract-upgrade @ ethereum ALONGSIDE the Provenance layer,
never replacing it. The asset carries a threshold-1 no-timelock Provenance key
AND a 1-day-timelocked Ethereum one, and only the Provenance one binds.
